## Packages

```{r}
# Packages
library(tidyverse)
library(haven) # SPSS file

# Models
library(MASS) # Ordered logit. Masks dplyr::select, so select is called as dplyr::select below
library(sandwich)
library(lmtest)
library(marginaleffects)

# Tables
library(texreg)
```

<br />

# Cleaning

```{r}
uniom <- read_sav("ward_jop_yougov_data.sav")

# Place identity: agrees or strongly agrees that they belong to their neighbourhood. Don't know is NA
uniom <- mutate(uniom,
  AW_localid_1strong = case_when(
    AW_localid_1 == 1 | AW_localid_1 == 2 ~ 1,
    AW_localid_1 == 6 ~ NA_real_,
    TRUE ~ 0
  )
)

# Controls
# Age group
uniom <- mutate(uniom,
  agec = case_when(
    age >= 18 & age <= 24 ~ 1,
    age >= 25 & age <= 39 ~ 2,
    age >= 40 & age <= 64 ~ 3,
    age >= 65 ~ 4
  )
)

# Female = 1
uniom <- mutate(uniom,
  gender = case_when(
    gender == 2 ~ 1,
    gender == 1 ~ 0
  )
)

# Social grade ABC1. Refused, unknown, skipped and not asked are NA
uniom$social_grade[uniom$social_grade == 7 | uniom$social_grade == 8 | uniom$social_grade == 98 | uniom$social_grade == 99] <- NA

uniom <- mutate(uniom,
  ABC1 = case_when(
    social_grade == 1 | social_grade == 2 | social_grade == 3 ~ 1,
    TRUE ~ 0
  )
)

# Education group: no qualifications / school or vocational / university or other higher. Don't know and prefer not to say are NA
uniom$education_level[uniom$education_level == 19 | uniom$education_level == 20 | uniom$education_level == 98 | uniom$education_level == 99] <- NA

uniom <- mutate(uniom,
  educationc = case_when(
    education_level == 1 ~ 1,
    education_level >= 2 & education_level <= 14 ~ 2,
    education_level >= 15 ~ 3
  )
)

# ONS urban-rural. Uncoded, skipped and not asked are NA
uniom$ONS_urban[uniom$ONS_urban == 10 | uniom$ONS_urban == 98 | uniom$ONS_urban == 99] <- NA

# Non-Conservative, including leaners. Don't know on both party items is NA
uniom <- mutate(uniom,
  noncon2 = case_when(
    AW_pid1 == 1 | AW_pid2 == 1 ~ 0,
    AW_pid1 == 9 & AW_pid2 == 4 ~ NA_real_,
    is.na(AW_pid1) & is.na(AW_pid2) ~ NA_real_,
    TRUE ~ 1
  )
)
```

```{r}
# Every respondent rated each trait for a Labour (candpref1) and a Conservative (candpref2) candidate
# Local traits: 3 born and raised locally, 4 living locally, 5 a job locally
# Important: extremely or very important for either candidate. Otherwise NA if either answer is don't know, skipped or not asked
important_either <- function(lab, con) {
  case_when(
    lab %in% c(1, 2) | con %in% c(1, 2) ~ 1,
    lab %in% c(6, 8, 9) | con %in% c(6, 8, 9) ~ NA_real_,
    TRUE ~ 0
  )
}

# Full scale: mean of the two ratings, reversed so higher = more important
reverse_imp <- function(x) {
  case_when(
    x >= 1 & x <= 5 ~ 6 - as.numeric(x),
    TRUE ~ NA_real_
  )
}

# Non-local traits, same coding: 1 a university degree, 2 having children, 6 previous political experience
for (i in c(1:6)) {
  lab <- uniom[[paste0("AW_candpref1_", i)]]
  con <- uniom[[paste0("AW_candpref2_", i)]]
  uniom[[paste0("AW_candpref3_", i, "strong")]] <- important_either(lab, con)
  uniom[[paste0("AW_candpref3_", i, "mean")]] <- (reverse_imp(lab) + reverse_imp(con)) / 2
}
```

<br />

# Main analysis

<br />

### Table 1 and Table A.3: Predicted probabilities

```{r}
# Logit models for the three local traits, born and raised / living / job
local_names <- c("Born and raised", "Living", "Job")
controls <- "noncon2 + agec + gender + ABC1 + educationc + political_attention + ONS_urban"

logit_local <- map(3:5, function(i) {
  glm(as.formula(paste0("AW_candpref3_", i, "strong ~ AW_localid_1strong + ", controls)),
    data = uniom,
    family = binomial(link = "logit")
  )
})

# Predicted probabilities with and without place identity, other covariates at their median or mode
Mode <- function(x) {
  ux <- unique(x)
  ux[which.max(tabulate(match(x, ux)))]
}

profile_base <- data.frame(noncon2 = median(uniom$noncon2, na.rm = TRUE), agec = median(uniom$agec, na.rm = TRUE), gender = median(uniom$gender, na.rm = TRUE), ABC1 = median(uniom$ABC1, na.rm = TRUE), educationc = Mode(uniom$educationc), political_attention = median(uniom$political_attention, na.rm = TRUE), ONS_urban = Mode(uniom$ONS_urban))
identity_profile <- mutate(profile_base, AW_localid_1strong = 1)
no_identity_profile <- mutate(profile_base, AW_localid_1strong = 0)

# Difference is identity minus no identity, delta-method CI
pred_ci <- map2_dfr(logit_local, local_names, function(m, trait) {
  bind_rows(
    predictions(m, newdata = bind_rows(no_identity_profile, identity_profile)) %>%
      as_tibble() %>%
      mutate(quantity = c("No identity", "Identity")),
    comparisons(m, variables = "AW_localid_1strong", newdata = identity_profile) %>%
      as_tibble() %>%
      mutate(quantity = "Difference")
  ) %>%
    transmute(trait = trait, quantity, estimate, conf.low, conf.high, p.value)
})

pred_ci

pred_ci_latex <- pred_ci %>%
  mutate(cell = sprintf("%.1f [%.1f, %.1f]", estimate * 100, conf.low * 100, conf.high * 100)) %>%
  dplyr::select(trait, quantity, cell) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = quantity, values_from = cell) %>%
  left_join(pred_ci %>% filter(quantity == "Difference") %>% transmute(trait, p = sprintf("%.3f", p.value)), by = "trait") %>%
  rename(Trait = trait, `$p$` = p) %>%
  knitr::kable(format = "latex", booktabs = TRUE, escape = FALSE, align = "lrrrr")
cat(pred_ci_latex, sep = "\n")
```

<br />

### Footnote to Table 1: Non-local traits

```{r}
# Same specification and quantity as Table 1, for the three non-local traits: identity minus no identity, other covariates at their median or mode
nonlocal_names <- c(`1` = "Degree", `2` = "Children", `6` = "Experience")
stopifnot(all(paste0("AW_candpref3_", names(nonlocal_names), "strong") %in% names(uniom)))
map_dfr(names(nonlocal_names), function(i) {
  m <- glm(as.formula(paste0("AW_candpref3_", i, "strong ~ AW_localid_1strong + ", controls)),
    data = uniom, family = binomial(link = "logit"))
  comparisons(m, variables = "AW_localid_1strong", newdata = identity_profile) %>%
    as_tibble() %>%
    transmute(trait = nonlocal_names[[i]], estimate = estimate * 100, conf.low = conf.low * 100, conf.high = conf.high * 100, p.value, n = nobs(m))
})
```

# Appendix

<br />

### Table A.1: Logit models

```{r}
coef_labels <- list(
  AW_localid_1strong = "Place identity",
  noncon2 = "Non-Conservative identifier",
  agec = "Age group",
  gender = "Female",
  ABC1 = "Social grade ABC1",
  educationc = "Education level",
  political_attention = "Political attention",
  ONS_urban = "ONS urban--rural category",
  "(Intercept)" = "Constant"
)

# Compact tables: keep N as the only fit statistic
s1_extract <- function(models) {
  map(models, function(m) {
    tr <- extract(m)
    keep <- tr@gof.names == "Num. obs."
    stopifnot(sum(keep) == 1)
    tr@gof.names <- tr@gof.names[keep]
    tr@gof <- tr@gof[keep]
    tr@gof.decimal <- tr@gof.decimal[keep]
    tr
  })
}

texreg(s1_extract(logit_local), single.row = TRUE,
  custom.model.names = local_names, custom.coef.map = coef_labels,
  booktabs = TRUE, use.packages = FALSE, float.pos = "H", digits = 2,
  caption = "Logit models of rating each local trait as important", label = "tab:s1-logit",
  custom.note = "\\footnotesize Logit coefficients, standard errors in parentheses. %stars."
)
```

<br />

### Table A.2: OLS and ordered logit on the full scale

```{r}
# Same models on the mean rating, 1-5, instead of the binary indicator
ols_full <- map(3:5, function(i) {
  lm(as.formula(paste0("AW_candpref3_", i, "mean ~ AW_localid_1strong + ", controls)),
    data = uniom
  )
})

ologit_full <- map(3:5, function(i) {
  polr(as.formula(paste0("factor(AW_candpref3_", i, "mean, ordered = TRUE) ~ AW_localid_1strong + ", controls)),
    data = uniom,
    Hess = TRUE
  )
})

texreg(s1_extract(c(ols_full, ologit_full)), fontsize = "footnotesize",
  custom.header = list("OLS" = 1:3, "Ordered logit" = 4:6),
  custom.model.names = rep(local_names, 2), custom.coef.map = coef_labels,
  booktabs = TRUE, use.packages = FALSE, float.pos = "H", digits = 2,
  caption = "Importance of local traits on the full scale", label = "tab:s1-fullscale",
  custom.note = "\\footnotesize Outcome is the mean importance rating across the Labour and Conservative candidate items, higher values more important. Ordered logit thresholds not shown. %stars."
)
```

<br />

### Table A.4: Stacked model, trait x identity

```{r}
# Long format, one row per respondent and local trait. Reference trait: born and raised locally
# The trait x identity terms test whether the identity effect differs between traits
uniom_long <- uniom %>%
  dplyr::select(ID, AW_localid_1strong, noncon2, agec, gender, ABC1, educationc, political_attention, ONS_urban, AW_candpref3_3strong, AW_candpref3_4strong, AW_candpref3_5strong) %>%
  pivot_longer(c(AW_candpref3_3strong, AW_candpref3_4strong, AW_candpref3_5strong), names_to = "trait", values_to = "important") %>%
  mutate(trait = factor(dplyr::recode(trait,
    "AW_candpref3_3strong" = "Born and raised",
    "AW_candpref3_4strong" = "Living",
    "AW_candpref3_5strong" = "Job"
  ), levels = local_names))
stopifnot(!any(is.na(uniom_long$trait)))

log_stacked <- glm(as.formula(paste("important ~ trait * AW_localid_1strong +", controls)),
          data = uniom_long,
          family = binomial(link = "logit")
          )

# SEs clustered on respondent, who contributes three rows
stacked_cl <- coeftest(log_stacked, vcov = vcovCL(log_stacked, cluster = ~ID))
stacked_cl

texreg(s1_extract(list(log_stacked)), single.row = TRUE,
  override.se = stacked_cl[, 2], override.pvalues = stacked_cl[, 4],
  custom.model.names = "Stacked logit",
  custom.coef.map = c(list(
    AW_localid_1strong = "Place identity",
    traitLiving = "Living",
    traitJob = "Job",
    "traitLiving:AW_localid_1strong" = "Place identity $\\times$ Living",
    "traitJob:AW_localid_1strong" = "Place identity $\\times$ Job"
  ), coef_labels[names(coef_labels) != "AW_localid_1strong"]),
  booktabs = TRUE, use.packages = FALSE, float.pos = "H", digits = 2,
  caption = "Stacked model of local trait importance", label = "tab:s1-stacked",
  custom.note = "\\footnotesize Logit coefficients. One row per respondent and trait, reference trait born and raised locally. Standard errors clustered on respondents. %stars."
)
```

<br />

### Table A.5: Place identity by party

```{r}
log_party <- map(3:5, function(i) {
  glm(as.formula(paste0("AW_candpref3_", i, "strong ~ AW_localid_1strong * noncon2 + agec + gender + ABC1 + educationc + political_attention + ONS_urban")),
    data = uniom,
    family = binomial(link = "logit")
  )
})

texreg(s1_extract(log_party), single.row = TRUE,
  custom.model.names = local_names,
  custom.coef.map = c(coef_labels[1:2], list("AW_localid_1strong:noncon2" = "Place identity $\\times$ Non-Conservative"), coef_labels[-(1:2)]),
  booktabs = TRUE, use.packages = FALSE, float.pos = "H", digits = 2,
  caption = "Place identity by party", label = "tab:s1-party",
  custom.note = "\\footnotesize Logit coefficients, standard errors in parentheses. %stars."
)
```
